CustomField.description: Snapshot of Order__c.Funding_Basis__c taken when the Order Ticket completed (see Allocation_TriggerHandler.setAllocationStrategies). Dollar sleeves are fixed carve-outs; Percent sleeves describe the actively traded remainder and total 100% across the allocation. Blank on snapshots taken before this field existed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Dollar = fixed amount that does not float with account value. Percent = share of the remainder after fixed-dollar sleeves.
CustomField.label: Funding Basis
